---
title: "03 -- Report"
---

Report the approved question, data provenance, mappings, methods, diagnostics,
missingness and limitations before interpreting results. Effect estimates are
shown only when computational diagnostics did not block the fit. Diagnostics are
evidence for review, not proof that model assumptions hold. Place
manuscript-specific files under the appropriate publication directory and cite
the packages actually used, including their versions.

```{r workflow-effects}
file <- "../output/tables/effects.csv"
if (file.exists(file)) {
  knitr::kable(utils::read.csv(file, check.names = FALSE), digits = 3, caption = "Study-data effect estimates")
} else {
  cat("No study-data model output yet.\n")
}
```
